scraped.title: Modules for climate risk
scraped.subtitle: Development and adoption of modules for climate risk, adaptation and blended finance training package in India
scraped.clientName: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
scraped.description: The GIZ project “Climate Adaptation, Resilience and Climate Finance in Rural India” (CAFRI II) aims to support the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) and the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) in strengthening capacities for…
body: The GIZ project “Climate Adaptation, Resilience and Climate Finance in Rural India” (CAFRI II) aims to support the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) and the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) in strengthening capacities for planning, implementation, financing, and monitoring of climate-risk informed interventions in rural India. In particular, the project aims to contribute to strengthening climate resilience and livelihood of women and other vulnerable groups, with a sectoral focus on agriculture and water. Further, the project aims to enhance climate finance in rural India.

In order to enhance institutional and human capacities within public institutions and implement climate adaptation measures at the local level and across the key sectors of water and agriculture, ICON supports the CAFRI II project by developing a modular training program focussing on
Integration of climate risks and adaptation action onto rural livelihood plans;
Design of multi-stakeholder engagements on gender-responsive climate adaptation; and
Engaging the profit & no-profit sector actors in cooperation and blended finance on climate adaptation.
